name: Hotel Waldhof
beschreibung: Hotel Waldhof is situated in scenic Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, surrounded by peaceful alpine meadows and the striking rock faces of the Wilder Kaiser. Designed in traditional Tyrolean country-house architecture, the hotel provides a warm and relaxing atmosphere. Guest rooms feature private balconies boasting panoramic mountain vistas. The dining experience includes classic half-board with a hearty breakfast buffet and multi-course regional dinners. Guests can unwind in the generous spa area complete with an indoor pool, multiple saunas, and serene relaxation rooms. Hiking trails start right at the hotel, while the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser cable cars are just minutes away via ski bus.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-friendly hotel in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser featuring an indoor pool, saunas, and mountain views.
